_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'clean' (site 1): the assets are C# that registers into DI (composer + attribute-routed controller), and the fixture needs real published content with blank optional properties, which Clean ships. The aliases are Clean's own: 'title'/'subtitle' are on every page type, 'mainImage' is a single media picker and 'author' a single content picker on Clean's 'article' type. The route prefix is unique to this example so it cannot collide with another example's controller. No `requires`: the fixture addresses nodes by key, which no requirement kind expresses, so it asserts its own preconditions (a 200 for the known keys) instead.
